strategies.name: RSI Mean Reversion
strategies.edgeTechnical: RSI(14) < 35 with positive slope; uptrend gate (SMA-100); exits RSI > 55 OR 20-day hold. 2.5× ATR stop, volume-spike filter.
strategies.edgePlain: Buys stocks that dropped too fast, betting they bounce back.
strategies.note: Low trade count: 2 closed trades (need 5+ for full scoring)

strategies.name: ML Momentum
strategies.edgeTechnical: LightGBM on 12 OHLCV+indicator features; calibrated P(5-day gain). SPY 50-SMA gate; accuracy-scaled confidence when OOS < 57%.
strategies.edgePlain: An AI model picks the stocks most likely to rise over the next week.

strategies.name: Earnings Drift
strategies.edgeTechnical: Post-earnings announcement drift (PEAD). Primary: earnings calendar. Fallback: volume > 1.3× + abnormal return > 3.5%. 20% target / 10% stop.
strategies.edgePlain: Rides the wave after a company posts strong earnings.

strategies.name: Factor Momentum
strategies.edgeTechnical: Cross-sectional rank: 60d momentum (25%), quality proxy (15%), mean-reversion (10%), volume confirmation (10%), excess SPY (15%), sector RS (10%), fundamentals (15% optional). Top 3.
strategies.edgePlain: Ranks all stocks and buys the 3 strongest all-around performers.

strategies.name: News Sentiment
strategies.edgeTechnical: Google News RSS + VADER. Buys when compound score > 0.60 with uptrend gate; exits when score drops or 7-day hold expires.
strategies.edgePlain: Buys stocks with strongly positive recent news, exits when the buzz fades.

strategies.name: MA Crossover
strategies.edgeTechnical: Golden cross (SMA-20 > SMA-50) with ADX > 20 trend-quality filter and volume confirmation (ratio > 0.3). 5-day lookback window.
strategies.edgePlain: Follows stocks whose short-term average price is rising above the longer-term average.

strategies.name: Volatility Breakout
strategies.edgeTechnical: Price closes above the VIX-adaptive Bollinger Band upper (1.8–2.5σ) with ≥ 1.2× volume spike and positive 5d return. Exits at BB-middle.
strategies.edgePlain: Buys stocks that break decisively upward on high volume.

strategies.name: Pairs Trading
strategies.edgeTechnical: Statistical mean-reversion on 5 cointegrated pairs (JPM/BAC, AAPL/MSFT, XOM/CVX, V/MA, ABBV/MRK). Buys lagging leg when ratio z-score < −1.5σ.
strategies.edgePlain: Buys a stock that has fallen behind its closest peer, betting the gap closes.
strategies.note: No activity in 30d (0 signals, 0 trades) — event-driven silence or new deployment

strategies.name: Sector Rotation
strategies.edgeTechnical: Ranks 7 sector ETFs by 20-day momentum; selects top 2. Buys the highest-momentum individual stock in each winning sector.
strategies.edgePlain: Rotates into the sectors of the market that are currently leading.
